reviews.title: Best app
reviews.text: this app got me out of my 3-month-long reading slump! i am so grateful and i love this app its so cute and you can decorate the avocado’s home. i named mine vee.

reviews.title: Glitching?
reviews.text: So i want to start out by saying that this app is amazing!!!! and i don’t know if this is a “my phone” problem but i go into the app and it glitches out and send me back to my homescreen. Its really weird and annoying. So if someone can maybe fix it please do and thank you!

reviews.title: Why
reviews.text: It will not let me open the app but other than that pretty good when I could open it so yeah

reviews.title: Happy! Question below:
reviews.text: Incredible app! Very happy with it. The only thing- I’ve completed it all! There’s no more rooms to do… and I don’t really want to change the furniture I’ve put in my current rooms. This app has really helped me focus in all parts of my life- hobbies, social time, work, and even my self care time. I didn’t realize how much I was using my phone until My Avocado- I named him Poot🤭 Although I’m very satisfied with the app, I can’t help but feel like there’s nothing else to do. It’s a little sad because I look forward to adding more to his home. Is there going to be an update with more rooms? Cozy kitchen, cozy bathroom, cozy game/hobby room. I hope so!!!

reviews.title: Absolutely helpful!!
reviews.text: This app has helped me put the phone down and get things done!  It has also helped me put the phone down just to take some time to rest!  Sometimes when my avocado is knitting, I’ll be in my comfy chair crocheting!  It’s a fun way to make sure I have plenty of screen free time every day!

reviews.title: Good concept
reviews.text: My phone overheated and I didn’t like how I had to leave it on while the avocado was focusing. I feel like that should be optional. But I think the idea is really good and cute

reviews.title: Loveeeee
reviews.text: I love focado it’s so fun to play i get more stuff done i like how you can decorate his house i have had it for 1 day and i love it already highly recommend !!!!!

reviews.title: Great concept however, I don’t need another thing to take care of
reviews.text: I was really excited about this app once I started using it. It helped me focus and it is adorable! However, the need to water the avocado takes the fun out of it. I already have a lot of tasks that require me to remember to keep up with things I don’t need a digital critter demanding me to give it water.

reviews.title: So much fun
reviews.text: Gives me a desire to be mindful but wishes it’s more than two rooms. I want to do a whole house

reviews.title: Copied from “Focus Friend”
reviews.text: I started with this app.  I was very frustrated that the free version doesn’t give you enough incentive to focus.  So I got the ad to buy pro for 40% off, and then another tie 55% off… but when you go to subscribe there is no discount! Then after using it for a while I was told this was actually a flat out copy of another app.  The story line is even WORD FOR WORD.  I’d be cool with a similar concept, but I draw the line at flat out copying. Deleted.

reviews.title: THIS APP RIPPED OFF FOCUS FRIEND
reviews.text: This app is a copy of Focus Friend, an app that came out a few months earlier and won an award. Do not use this app, use Focus Friend. This app just plagiarized the entire setup and system but used an avocado instead. Support the original developers and get the Focus Friend app!

reviews.title: Really enjoying this
reviews.text: This is such a cute idea! One request, would be great to have an option to not let my phone “go to sleep” when I’m focusing so I can keep an eye on the timer.

reviews.title: Bad customer service - subscription that doesn’t give you access
reviews.text: I downloaded this from a video on an official ad and it asked me there to do a subscription before downloading the app so I did but then it didn’t transfer to the app and then it charged me when I couldn’t even use the subscription I reached out to support and they told me to just accept the free trial on the app which would create another charge with no way to cancel the first one.

reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text: My first issue is that as someone with ADHD just a timer doesn’t help. There is 0 punishment for getting on your phone unless you pay monthly. My second issue is that my motion keep disappearing I had over 200 and haven’t bought anything. I now have 71 which unmotivates me when my reward doesn’t even exist.

reviews.title: very useful for my daughter
reviews.text: 10 out of 10

reviews.title: Wish it could be a zero
reviews.text: You have to pay just to use the app and it’s so stupid. When I got the app I didn’t see anything about having to pay to use it.

reviews.title: Frustrating.
reviews.text: I need to keep certain apps available but it doesn’t matter if they’re checked or not checked, I still can’t have my music or books…. I can’t focus in silence. I paid for pro and still can’t use it.

reviews.title: So helpful and so fun!
reviews.text: This is such a unique app. It really helps me focus on work and chores but it’s also so fun. It makes getting stuff done addictive because I get to upgrade my Focado’s home as I earn rewards from getting stuff done in IRL😊 10/10 ADHD app🔥

reviews.title: cute little avocado!
reviews.text: great app! I have ADHD and this cute avocado helps me focus when I can’t concentrate!

reviews.title: ACTUALLY DOING MY WORK NOW
reviews.text: Idk why but I just have such a hard time focusing for long periods of time, and using a normal timer just never helps, but something about helping your own avacado decorate his home when you focus makes it actually fun to focus up and get  work done lol
